origin: OpenCode 1.18.16 with the model gpt-5.5, as the client sends it: it asks for verbosity low and reasoning_effort medium in every request, and a gpt request is sent whole to its native accounts. The relay serves it all the same: a verbosity is only advice about the length of the answer (soft, D6), so it is left out of the relay's body and recorded among the features the answer was made without. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
